title: Safety on every jobsite and in the shop
intro: Our crews work on occupied schools, hospitals and businesses. Safe work protects our people, your site and your schedule.

practices.title: Jobsite orientation
practices.text: Crews complete the general contractor's site orientation and follow site-specific safety rules before work begins.

practices.title: Personal protective equipment
practices.text: Safety glasses, hearing protection, gloves and proper footwear in the shop and on site, with additional PPE as the site requires.

practices.title: Machine safety in the shop
practices.text: Guarded equipment, trained operators and lockout/tagout before machine maintenance.

practices.title: Toolbox talks
practices.text: Regular safety talks with shop and field crews on the hazards of the work ahead.

practices.title: Clean, protected work areas
practices.text: Debris is removed as we work, and finished surfaces are protected until turnover.

practices.title: Occupied-space awareness
practices.text: Work areas are kept clear and secured in schools, clinics and other occupied buildings.

insurance: Certificates of insurance naming the general contractor and owner as additional insured are available on request.
